dietaryNote: V vegetarian · VG vegan · GF gluten-free ingredients. We bake with flour, nuts and sesame on site. Please tell us about any allergies before ordering.

about.heading: Baked here, every morning
body: Larkspur started with a sourdough starter and a borrowed oven. Today we bake about 60 loaves a day, plus buns, pastries and whatever’s in season.
We buy flour from a UK mill and veg from local growers, and we compost our coffee grounds.
